# Reading projection — `telegram.md`

Every rule `telegram.md` owns, one entry each: the rule's own statement from `conformance_suite.md`'s matrix, and a link to the heading that argues it. The argument, the cost, the prior art, and the walkthrough are in [`telegram.md`](../telegram.md) and are not repeated here (decision 66).

17 rules.

## [A chat message is not an instruction](../telegram.md#a-chat-message-is-not-an-instruction)

- **TG-1** — a message never opens, claims, closes, names, sets, advances, cancels, reprioritizes, halts, or takes *[M]*
- **TG-2** — the same: the two conditions of the narrow path; a reply failing either is an observation *[M]*

## [Which checkpoint a reply answers is decided by correlation, not by reading the text](../telegram.md#which-checkpoint-a-reply-answers-is-decided-by-correlation-not-by-reading-the-text)

- **TG-3** — correlation is structural; no readable decision is `unknown` and holds; recency never decides *[M]*

## [The callback payload is the swarm's own text, and free text is not](../telegram.md#the-callback-payload-is-the-swarms-own-text-and-free-text-is-not)

- **TG-4** — a callback from a non-approver is an observation; an unrecognized payload is dropped; a stale payload is an observation with the reason back; the token is not a capability; acknowledgement is not resolution *[M]*

## [Commands](../telegram.md#commands)

- **TG-5** — a command is a task except the two reads; the halt is not a command *[M]*

## [Chats, groups, and who can see what](../telegram.md#chats-groups-and-who-can-see-what)

- **TG-6** — the sender's credential is resolved per delivery, never the chat's; coverage records the partial view *[M]*

## [Delivery: webhooks, long polling, and what the dedup rule keys on](../telegram.md#delivery-webhooks-long-polling-and-what-the-dedup-rule-keys-on)

- **TG-7** — dedup is a membership test over a window, never a high-water mark; acknowledgement follows the confirmed write *[M]*

## [Identity that moves under the record](../telegram.md#identity-that-moves-under-the-record)

- **TG-8** — a placeholder message id is not a confirmation *[M]*

## [Conditions that are not updates](../telegram.md#conditions-that-are-not-updates)

- **TG-9** — a deleted or edited message retracts nothing *[M]*

## [What the adapter does not write, and what it does not fetch](../telegram.md#what-the-adapter-does-not-write-and-what-it-does-not-fetch)
